witnesses.Berendts 1906: German rendering of the eight; public domain; scan not yet located (see NEGATIVE-SEARCH.md)
witnesses.Meshcherskii 1958: critical Russian text; in copyright; cited not seated
witnesses.Leeming & Leeming 2003: synoptic English edition (Brill); in copyright; cited not seated

transmission: Popov 1866 (first notice) → Sreznevsky 1879 (Rus' chronicle language) → Berendts 1906 (translation + Vorlage thesis) → Eisler 1931 vs. Zeitlin–Feldman–Meier consensus → Pines 1971 (Syriac-corridor plausibility)
